"""Camera-guided PackDessert controller. Uses only rcb_client observations.
All executed actions and observations are saved alongside this script.
"""
from rcb_client import Robot
import numpy as np, json
from pathlib import Path
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation
from scipy.optimize import least_squares
r=Robot(); spec=r.spec(); root=Path('/app/output'); seq=0
obs=r.get_obs(include_depth=True,video='none')
q=np.array(obs.meta['proprio']['now'][4:11]); grip=-1
history=[]
def state(o=None):
 o=obs if o is None else o
 p=np.array(o.meta['proprio']['now']);return p[4:11],p[26:29],np.array(o.meta['cameras']['robot0_eye_in_hand']['cam2world_gl'])[:3,:3]
def save(o):
 global seq
 seq+=1;o.save(root/f'run{seq:03d}');
 (root/'latest.json').write_text(json.dumps({'seq':seq,'meta':o.meta}))
 print('saved',seq,'eef',state(o)[1], 'q',state(o)[0], 'fingers',o.meta['proprio']['now'][11:13], 'time',o.meta['time_left_s'],flush=True)
def move(qto,seconds=1.5,g=None,base=None):
 global obs,q,grip
 if g is not None:grip=g
 n=max(1,int(seconds/.05));A=np.zeros((n,13));A[:,:7]=np.linspace(q,np.array(qto),n);A[:,7]=grip;A[:,12]=-1
 if base is not None:A[:,8:12]=base
 history.append(A);np.savez(root/'actions.npz',*history)
 obs=r.submit('joint_position',A,include_depth=True,video='none');q=state()[0];save(obs);return obs

def watch(seconds=0):
 global obs,q
 obs=r.get_obs(seconds=seconds,include_depth=True,video='none');q=state()[0];save(obs)

def xyz(u,v,cam='robot0_eye_in_hand',o=None):
 o=obs if o is None else o
 c=o.meta['cameras'][cam];K=np.array(c['intrinsic_cv']);T=np.array(c['cam2world_gl']);d=o.depth[cam].squeeze();z=float(d[v,u]);return (T@[(u-K[0,2])*z/K[0,0],-(v-K[1,2])*z/K[1,1],-z,1])[:3]

def calibrate(eps=.035):
 global J
 q0,p0,R0=state();cols=[]
 for j in range(7):
  qt=q0.copy();qt[j]+=eps;move(qt,0.7)
  q1,p1,R1=state();cols.append(np.r_[p1-p0,Rotation.from_matrix(R1@R0.T).as_rotvec()]/(q1[j]-q0[j]))
  move(q0,0.7)
  q0,p0,R0=state()
 J=np.array(cols).T;np.save(root/'jacobian.npy',J);print('J',J,flush=True)

def servo(target,Rtarget=None,steps=5,limit=.1):
 global J
 target=np.array(target)
 if Rtarget is None:Rtarget=state()[2]
 for i in range(steps):
  q0,p0,R0=state();err=np.r_[target-p0,Rotation.from_matrix(Rtarget@R0.T).as_rotvec()]
  print('error',err,flush=True)
  if np.linalg.norm(err[:3])<.002 and np.linalg.norm(err[3:])<.015:break
  dq=J.T@np.linalg.solve(J@J.T+.0001*np.eye(6),err)
  dq*=min(1,limit/max(abs(dq)))
  move(q0+dq,1.0)
  q1,p1,R1=state();actual=q1-q0;dy=np.r_[p1-p0,Rotation.from_matrix(R1@R0.T).as_rotvec()]
  J+=np.outer(dy-J@actual,actual)/(actual@actual+1e-10)
  np.save(root/'jacobian.npy',J)

save(obs)
print('Ready',flush=True)
